This is [your] own objection, to be refuted.&quot; To refute it: &gt; There, the one — the inner essence — attaining the organ-known-ness, &gt; goes into the many-ness, by the place-time-own-nature. In the action, etc. — once their truth-ness is established, or for the action, etc. — the one-ness and many-ness that are spoken of are, even when subordinated in the Vṛtti, to be established here as the primary known-object. Having reflected, [Abhinavagupta makes] the determination: of the two, between the one-ness and the many-ness, [he takes] the one-ness itself — &quot;this way it is established; and the many-ness, this way.&quot; Of the blue and other beings, the param-essence is the inner [essence], the marker being consciousness-mere; there is no computation there, because of the dense non-distinction, even of the one-ness, there, from its non-being. But what is inner — the un-mixed with other appearances, the inner-going — and inner, known by the inner-organ-mere, the one essence. That one, again, without abandoning its one-ness, attaining the external-organ-known- ness, &quot;here-there, now-then, thin-not-thin,&quot; from the place-and-the-rest distinction, goes into the many-ness. And there is no opposition, because the cognition is un-broken, like of the cause-ness/ non-cause-ness two, with the dealing-mere-param-essence-ness, of the object-distinction even, from its well-sayableness. Hence, of the one-ness/many-ness two, there is no opposition at all; &quot;Caitra moves,&quot; in the action; thus, in th[is case]… ### Kārikā 3 — the mind-re-determination makes the conceptions [Objection:] &quot;From the object-distinction, &#x27;one, many,&#x27; that which is said — by what is it to be grasped? With the eye-experience, first, Caitra manifests as divided by the place-distinction alone; this [cognition] has no capacity to mix the appearance-distinctions, because of its un-investigating-ness — so they say; but with the construction, the mental one, the object is not verily touched.&quot; Then, here, it is said with the sūtra: &gt; These, supporting the two, the mind-re-determining, being, &gt; make the action-and-the-rest conceptions, made of the knower-operation. Here, although even in the un-constructed [perception], in the being-mere/jar-mere manifestation, the universal, etc., has its appearance, in the extended grasping, and even, of the yogin, the action-manifestation, the time-manifestation, it could be said; still, then, that universal, etc., does not attain its own life. For: the staining-ness by the universal, the rising of the relation-distinction, the grasping of the unity of the streaming-moment-distinctions, the making of the part-mass, the manifestation of the limit/limitable — this is the &quot;life&quot; of the universal/relation/action/substance/direction appearances; and that, in the construction, is clearly manifested. And the construction, of the mind, is manifested in the re-determination, at the occasion of the māyā-knower. By that, the mind, the agent, making the re-determination — the reflexive-awareness that comes after the direct-manifestation-reflexive-awareness — [makes] the action/relation-and-the-rest object… &gt; &quot;in the one-utterance-object, the cognition…&quot; (2.3.2) This is [what] will be said. He explains the &#x27;anu&#x27;-word, &quot;after (paścāt).&quot; &quot;The mind alone makes the conceptions&quot; — the connection. &quot;Of that, the own-form specific-marker, &#x27;the instrument,&#x27; to the end; the two &#x27;śatr&#x27; endings, however, carry the reason-embryo, in the making of the conception.&quot; &quot;Between which two does the mind stand, in the Vṛtti?&quot; — having doubted, [he answers:] &quot;of the grasped-grasper two,&quot; he shows, &quot;external, and the rest,&quot; &quot;of that, to the end,&quot; with the sentence. &quot;With the knower together, the distinction and the connection, resting in the absence, unable to deal — of which.&quot; &quot;Of that,&quot; of the knower. Here, the reason, he gives: &quot;of the knower.&quot; &quot;The knower, the external and the inner, the to-be-constructed, the object — which he determines, with the varied joinings; that very one is said [to be] the action/universal-and-the-rest.&quot; &quot;He deals&quot; — he makes the Vṛtti-joining, &quot;the mental-ness, and the rest.&quot; &quot;The reason&quot; — the remainder of the three sentences. [Objection:] &quot;Who, another, is the knower…&quot; &gt; &quot;if not, the inner-made…&quot; (1.3.7) to this end, and the rest. &quot;The impression-born&quot; — for the impression indeed culminates in the knower-unity, it is said. Hence, as the Buddhists think the experience-impression-born-ness, so here it does not become — this is to be thought. &quot;And in the eye-and-the-rest, and the rest,&quot; &quot;the resting-ness, to the end,&quot; — the intention has been explained at the very beginning of the sūtra-explanation. And here, with the &#x27;universal&#x27;-grasping, everything, the relation-and-the-rest, he marks. &quot;The universal-form even&quot; — the un-clear-more, the meaning. &quot;The universal is said&quot; — not &quot;the universal,&quot; they are dealt. Here, to give room for the reason, &quot;of them, and the rest,&quot; [and] the to-be-said, for the manifestation of the universal-own-form, he says, &quot;of the specific-ones, following, to the end.&quot; [Objection:] &quot;Here, at this occasion, he — the one-alone-appearance — what is to be said? Not, first, &#x27;the universal,&#x27; you alone declared…&quot; &gt; &quot;thus alone, the being-jar…&quot; (2.3.5) in this. That, how is it said, &quot;in the other-appearance-mixed-ness alone is the object-action&quot;? Here, the answer, he gives: &quot;place, and the rest.&quot; Here, now: &quot;the is, the thus-ness alone, the being-manifestation, has become the own-marker&quot; — with the form/blue-and-the-rest appearances, the external-limb, in the own-marker-ness, the non-helpers, what deed is there? With the place-time- manifestations two, without [which], not even with the appearance-thousands, in the mixing even, does the own-marker-ness end: &quot;the blue, the cloth, the extended, the cotton, the soft, the thin, and the rest,&quot; from the flashing of the universal-form-ness alone. &quot;This-that,&quot; however, — the place-time-manifestation-mixing — removes the universal-form-ness. Hence, he alone is the inner-limb, in the own-marker-ness-arrival. This very [point] he establishes: &quot;of the two alone,&quot; of the place-time two, with the east-west-and-the-rest-form-ness. The place is the far/near-marker; the prior-later variety… &gt; &quot;with the camasa they bring the rice, he sprinkles the ṣoḍaśin, he takes it&quot; and the rest — even so, [the word] is not able to make known the specific, the present- manifestation; the meaning perceived from the word, without the finger-point-and-the-rest-helper, is perceived as the place-time-un-cut alone — this meaning is the effortless-established. And this will be [so] in the valid-means-marker. With this much, the re-determination-operation alone revives the universal/action-and-the-rest essence. That which is current, that he determines [and] summarizes: &quot;thus, and.&quot; &quot;In this,&quot; where the own-marker/universal-form-ness is reflection-fit, such [a case]. &quot;Not then,&quot; at the mental-determination time. &quot;The universal, in this very [word],&quot; — the cut. Here, the reason, &quot;place-and-the-rest&quot;; the connection even, &quot;then&quot;; the action even, &quot;then&quot; — the connection. The other sentence is the reason-form. &quot;The said,&quot; &quot;the mind-re- determining,&quot; &quot;the conceptions,&quot; and — &quot;will be said&quot;: &gt; &quot;… the constructions support (ālambante)&quot; (2.2.5) This is the verse, the 3. Thus, with this much, in the convention, in the construction-mind, of the flashing universal-and-the-rest: the conventional-being-ness, the name — the being-ness- specific alone — stands; not, like in the double-moon-and-the-rest, the un-truth — it is established. There, this is the bringing-into-order: of the consciousness, &quot;all this, with the freedom-recollection-marker, is the unfolded of the action-power&quot; — that which is the relation/universal-and-the-rest. There even, the relation-form-ness alone — the many-one-form-ness- marker — everywhere is the essence-form. There, though, with the un-common-form-other-joining, the other name. &quot;Of the many-individual-mass, he who is the unity-own, the relation — there, &#x27;cows,&#x27; with the tolerance of the other designation.&quot; There, the universal-speech, in the many-moment-flow, from the support-strength, becomes one; &quot;moves,&quot; with the designation-strength, the action-dealing; &quot;of the threads-one-ness, &#x27;this is the cloth,&#x27;&quot; the substance-dealing; &quot;of the childhood-and-the- rest-states-one-ness,&quot; the state-possessor-dealing. Thus, elsewhere… &gt; &quot;the distinction-un-distinction-self-relation, the all-objects-established; &gt; the world-path…&quot; (ślo. 1) This is said in the relation-establishment. Even by the divided-universal-holders, of the inherence, of the relation, &quot;it helps,&quot; — &quot;the relation,&quot; with the rule, with the relation, or, of the helped, from the acceptance. And the relation, the one-many-ness-made, the knower-freedom-own, with the action-power-glory. Hence, the relation alone, in the knower-unity-establishment, is the root: &gt; &quot;… in the relation, the attentiveness&quot; (vi. bhai. 106) of the statement. That very [point], to investigate, the sūtra: ### Kārikā 4 — the relation as the mutual-form-clinging in the one knower &gt; The self-resting, distinct-manifestation beings, in the one knower, &gt; joined by the mutual-relation-form-unity, [are] the relation-mind-word. &quot;The king and the person,&quot; since [they are] with the distinct-ness, outside, are manifested; thence, in the own-self alone, in the completion, in the thus-form alone, when, in the one knower, they partake of the unity. And that is not the unity-mere, in the melting of the own-form, from the relation-unfitness; but with the mutual-form-clinging, the simultaneous-drowning-emerging, the distinction-un-distinction-phase-two, the swing-machine-form — the relation-marker. And that too is not with the knower alone; but mutually, &quot;of the king the person,&quot; or, of that, &quot;the king.&quot; Merely, in the attaining of that-being, the consciousness-touch of these, with the means-mere-ness, is accepted — like the fire, in the gold-drop-mingling, not breaking its own-form at all. With the thus-form unity, the two being joined, the beings, of the relation-mind, &quot;of the king the person, and the rest,&quot; [are] the word, the object. Everywhere, the two-resting-alone, the re[lation]… &gt; &quot;with that-self alone, of that, would be, how, with the breath, the control&quot; (ślo. 21) This is [it]. Thence, in the māyāya-standing even, in the distinction, with the manifestation-glory, the un-distinction does not deviate. &quot;One-one&quot; — he alone is the operation of the māyā-knower, by which the relation-form, that being-two, is created, and manifested, and reflected. &quot;The distinct&quot; — from the prior, of the relation-less-state, the distinct-marker, the meaning. Thence-alone, with the construction-operation, connected with the knower, from the unveiled-ness, with the inner-organ- known-ness, from the un-common-ness, with the knower-distinction, of the being, in the relation- variety, the relation-state, and, becoming, is not flawed. &quot;Somewhere, in the appearance-part indeed, the param-Lord, sometimes, mixes the knowers, and he unjoins the others, and the rest&quot; — this is said many times. [Objection:] &quot;The distinction-un-distinction-made-ness alone is the relation-marker, with the quality/primary-ness, of the relation-two…&quot; ### Kārikā 5 — the class and substance manifestations are one-form outside too Now, from the relation-grace, in the unity/non-unity-made-ness even, as the distinction-ness of the class-and-the-rest manifestations; thus, to declare the other distinction, he begins: &gt; Of the class-substance-manifestations, outside even, the one-form-ness; &gt; the individual-part-distinction, and too, [are] supported by the constructions. &quot;Of the class-manifestations, of the appearance-param-essences, of the classes, those which are the grasping and reflexively-aware constructions, the construction-minds — they, not alone within the unity, but outside too the non-unity alone, objectify. Inasmuch as, outside even, with the one- cow-ness-following, the unity — the purpose of the one-nominal-word-application, and the helper of the plural-word-application — and the distinction, gone to the individual, the necessarily-support- become-individual-grasping, they support, manifest, and reflect, &#x27;these cows,&#x27; with the external- facing-ness alone, of the un-distinction, with the qualifier-ness, and of the distinction, with the qualified-ness, with the to-be-stained-ness, from the cognition.&quot; Thus, of the substance- manifestations, the constructions, outside even, the one-ness, and the part-distinction, they support: &quot;jar,&quot; with the un-knot-binding-ness, of the one, with the extended-ness, of the many-part… &gt; &quot;of the other-self, that which is the self, with that-self-like, is manifested&quot; (vā. pa. 3.3.9) This is [it]. &quot;Thence-alone,&quot; what is said, &quot;the one-many-form-ness, this-form, in the eye-seen, is not manifested,&quot; extendedly; &quot;thence-from-the-reason,&quot; the meaning. &quot;Would be,&quot; with the reason, is conceivable, first, from the present-object-manifestation-ness, of the eye-seen, of the universal/part-possessor-and-the-rest, with the all-common-ness, of the clear, then even, from the presence. When he says, the Kaṇavat-muni: &gt; &quot;from the form-substance-inherence, the eye-seen, the universals&quot; (4.1.11) This is [it]. &quot;From the un-manifestation,&quot; with the distinction-own-form-marker-primary-ness alone, from the cognition-rest, the meaning. &quot;Caitra.&quot; Although the jar-and-the-rest even is the part- possessor-agreed alone, and thus he will say, &quot;from the other sesame, and the rest&quot;; still, &quot;this-I, this-much, I go, I stand,&quot; — to show that the one-ness-recollection has no deviation, in any manner, in the life-body, this was said. &quot;The jar indeed, like the house-chariot-village-army-and-the-rest, even being the aggregate-own-nature, could be the one-object-action-doing&quot; — the conceivability. &quot;The childhood-and-the-rest-states&quot; — not, here, of the states, the unity-continuation is intended, of that, in the part-possessor-mind, from the non-helper-ness; but, &quot;this-much-I, this now, from the prior-form, with this much, the distinct-extended, the un-knot-binding&quot; — here, the intention. Thence-alone, with the divided, the part-p[ossessor]… Then, with the &#x27;ḍatar&#x27;-and-the-rest reading, with the &#x27;ḍa&#x27; substitution, &quot;one-of-them.&quot; &quot;The cognizer&quot; — the utterer, and the cognizer, here, is intended. &quot;The cognition-doer-ness, in the utterer; the cognition-teacher-ness, in the cognizer; the cognition-bringer-ness.&quot; This is what is said: &quot;by the utterer, with the black-shadow-beginning, in the heart-standing cow, when the word- application is made; then, even the white-shadow, foregrounding, the cognizer, the cow, of the cognizer, even the kapila-color, if he brings — both, the maker-conceit-possessing, become alone.&quot; That, if the un-fixed-ness, not [so]; how, this way, does it fit? And from the un-fixed-ness, of the all-own-markers, the cognition is the effortless-established. &quot;Where,&quot; in the chariot- manifestation. &quot;Immediately-alone,&quot; with the king-person-and-the-rest-relation-rule. &quot;With the conjunction,&quot; with the non-inherence-cause-ness, being manifested, wit[h]… &gt; &quot;from the far, the one-dense, the forest&quot; like-that. Of the many, in the simultaneous-grasping, of the interior, in the non-grasping, this-way alone the manifestation fits, from the fitness, &quot;the coarse, the one-dense&quot;; not-in-truth, otherwise. Thence, in the manifestation-being, of the external, this is the dharma, manifesting; or, of the manifestation alone, in the with-form-consciousness-view, of the cognition-form-marker, this is the dharma; not of the external — this is [it]. The thus-manifestation, this, &quot;the part-possessor- manifestation,&quot; is not fit to say. Thus, the perception — the valid-means — which is shown by the other, in the part-possessor-establishment: &gt; &quot;the all-non-grasping, from the part-possessor-establishment&quot; (nyā. 2.1.34) with the sūtra, that is rejected. Now: &gt; &quot;from the holding-drawing-fitness, and too&quot; (nyā. 2.1.35) This is [it]; that which is the inference-said, that too he rejects, making the reason otherwise- established: &quot;the atom-aggregate, and the rest.&quot; &quot;From the own-nature-variety,&quot; of the jar-and-the- rest, those which are the atoms, of them, with the own-cause-strength, with the that-being- following, from the birth; and of the jar-and-the-rest, those which are the enjoyers, their actions, there, the superintending-condition. The &#x27;vā&#x27;-word, in the aggregation. And this, even by the part- possessor-holder, of the conjunctions, of the non-inherence-causes, for the protection, in the wind- conjunction-and-the-rest, [for] the cause, the of-necessity-accepted, in the non-production of the rise-division-beginning-action. Thus, the establishing valid-means having rejected, the refuting, in the part-possessor, he shows: &quot;one, and the rest.&quot; This is the own-form-come, the refuter. Even with the holding-quality-prior-starting-dharma-face, him he addresses: &quot;the two-atom, and the rest.&quot; Thus alone, the thread-gone… With the holding, with the balance-excess, in the cloth, the more-more of the balance, the bending would be. Here, in the prior-view, the counter-measure is said. There, in brief, first, all this he refutes: &quot;would-be, and the rest,&quot; &quot;the objects, to the end.&quot; &quot;This is the flaw&quot; — the establishing- non-being, the refuting-being, the form. Now, this very [point] he makes clear: &quot;thus, and,&quot; in this brief, the standing — the meaning. &quot;And by the other, &#x27;of the atoms the aggregate alone, this-way, shines&#x27;&quot; — that which is said; there, in the aggregate-manifestation, the famous, that which is the divided-manifestation-ness, the interior-non-grasping-raised-conjunction, the name, from the co- helper alone, from the pervasion-ness, the one-juice-distinction-emerging, the pervading; that he shows: &quot;the mass.&quot; That non-apprehension, in the current, he fits: &quot;this-which-is-the-Caitra- manifestation, and the rest.&quot; [Objection:] &quot;if, the one alone…&quot; ### Kārikā 6 — the kāraka-conjunction is the action-reflexive-awareness-object In the action-adjunct-relation even, the distinction-un-distinction two are reflected, with the sūtra; and with that occasion, of the direction-and-the-rest, the own-form: &gt; The action-reflexive-awareness-object, of the adjuncts, the conjunction; &gt; the limit-limitable-being-relation-supporting, the direction-and-the-rest-mind. &quot;The not-elsewhere-being-marker, the cause-ness&quot; — here, the object-meaning. In the Vṛtti-sentence even, thus. &quot;The adjunct,&quot; the substance, and the power. &quot;This is the joining: of the power- supporting, of the substances, that which is the conjunction — he, with the joining-glue-place, the action-recollection-cause, as, of the valid-means-known two, the cognition-cause; and the cognition, the knower-rest-ness&quot; — this is [it], in the agent, in the consciousness-form, that which is the un-distinction-attainment, of the divided even, of the adjuncts, he alone is the conjunction. Thus, of the wood-pot-and-the-rest, in the cooking-agent, is to be said. Thus, of the adjunct-powers even, the conjunction, the agent-rest-ending-alone, with the action-face, from its unfolding; and of the action, in the agent, from the rest. Thus, of the action, with the own-marker-expectation, and with the first-adjunct-expectation, that which is the distinction; and that which is, with the one-agent- rest, with the result-un… &gt; &quot;the action-relation…&quot; (2.2.1) and the rest. There, of the action alone, first, the distinction-un-distinction two, with the adjunct-face, establishing, the distinction, first, he states: &quot;of the adjuncts, and the rest.&quot; &quot;With the that-form-stain-entry, the action is manifested&quot; — this is [it], the distinction-form-ness, of this. Thus, he states, in the adjunct-vārtika: &gt; &quot;the divided, of the cooking, the own-form, with the adjunct-distinction, of that-mind&quot; This is [it], of the action-mind. Now, the un-distinction even, he states: &quot;and &#x27;cooks,&#x27;&quot; with the &#x27;ca&#x27;-word, with the distinction together, the un-distinction he aggregates. &quot;&#x27;Cooks,&#x27;&quot; there, in the recollection: of the action-mind, the un-distinction-object-ness; since, this-form, the cooking- freedom-made, he who is the agent, with the that-one-possessed-ness, she, the action, with that mind, is objectified. And of that, of the agent, the one-form-ness, is the param-essence. This is what is said: &quot;with the woods, with the pot, the rice-gruel, &#x27;Caitra cooks&#x27;&quot; — the sentence-known meaning; she, in-truth, is the action. Thence-alone, &quot;the verb-word, the sentence,&quot; is said, by this honorable-one. And there, the wood-gone burning-and-the-rest; the pot-gone heating-and-the-rest; the rice-grain-gone splitting-and-the-rest — that which is, that, &quot;the cooking-form, thus,&quot; with the distinction, in the recollection, flashes even; in the Caitra-consciousness-freedom-rest, the un-distinction alone ends. This known-object he summarizes: &quot;the action-mind even.&quot; Not alone the relation-mind is the many-object — the &#x27;api&#x27;. [Objection:] &quot;previously-alone…&quot; &gt; &quot;the with-order-ness, and, of the worldly, of the action…&quot; (2.1.2) This is [it]. &quot;The true; this, though, otherwise, of the distinction, the determination.&quot; Then he says: &quot;not-alone.&quot; &quot;From the agent-unity, and,&quot; — not alone, from the result-unity, the meaning. Thus, the action, the one-many-form, having established, of the Vṛtti-sentence, &quot;the mind, to the end,&quot; of the that-explained, of the verse-half, the current meaning, with the intention, he explains: &quot;there,&quot; in the Vṛtti-sentence, in the verse-half. &quot;The adjunct-ness-mind even, that which is, she, of the divided even, of the adjunct-substances, becoming, the one-object even, the many-object&quot; — &quot;in the adjunct-ness, the mind,&quot; this, here, is said. Of the action-adjunct-ness-non-being-cognition, and of the remainder-relation-cognition, in the one-many-object-ness, in the equal, the distinction- ness, he states: &quot;of the king,&quot; &quot;the cognition, the meaning.&quot; [Objection:] &quot;in the remainder-relation even, the action-adjunct-prior-ness is said,&quot; having doubted… &gt; &quot;not, without the number, anyone, the being-become, the meaning, is declared&quot; This is [it]. There, though, of the nominal-meaning, the number-manifestation attains the adjunct- being. For of the case-ending-meaning, this is the own-nature: that which is, in the nominal-meaning, the quality-becoming. Thence, with the &#x27;one&#x27;-and-the-rest words, the mutual-cut-manifestation, with the primary-ness, is recollected. And by that, the object-form alone, the number-and-its-distinction- own. The number, though, the distinction-counting-own, is said. &quot;The measure even&quot;: &gt; &quot;the atom, the great, the short, the long, and&quot; This is [it], that which is the measure, of the Kāṇādas, the famous; there, the short-long, this first: &gt; &quot;the length, though, the measure, would be…&quot; the measure-marker-attained. And the measure, the name, [is] the cut-other-object-expecting; with the twenty-four-digit-ness, the famous, he who is the hand-manifestation, with him, he who is the comparison-manifestation, not, outside, the conjunction-mere; that. Thence-alone, he says: &quot;the measure even,&quot; with the inner-unity-part, of the to-be-measured, of the cloth, with the expecting, with the hand, from the conjunction-attainment — the yard-stick-taking, for the raising of the short-long-distinction. &quot;The atom-great, however,&quot; — that which is said; there, the atom-ness, if the part-less-ness-mere, that, of the quality-action-and-the-rest, of the part-less, would be. Now, of the substance, the part-less-ness — the atom-ness; then, of the space even, would be. Thence, with the very-subtle-ness, with the famous, from the mustard-pod-gram-box-small-box, the lightest-alone, that which is, from all sides, the cut-fit-ness, that very is the atom-ness; the other, the great-ness… &gt; &quot;… the measure, though, from all sides&quot; with this, it is grasped. Then he says: &quot;the prastha-kudava,&quot; of the to-be-measured, of the sesame- and-the-rest, with the expecting, with the wood-cup-like, everywhere, the measure-comparison- manifestation-marker, that which is the measure; not-in-truth, the conjunction-mere; that even, with the inner-unity-part. And that which is the unmāna, the name, &quot;the upward-measure,&quot; is marked; that, by the Kāṇādas, the weight-alone, the falling-action-maker, is said; not-in-truth, thus, not, it becomes, in the weight-mere, the measure-dealing-non-being; but, the famous, that which is, with the moment-and-the-rest, the weight; that-comparison alone, the unmāna, is fit — the grammarians. And thus, the measure-ness, the name, in the three, is the same. &quot;The extended, the around, with the upward-ness, or,&quot; the measure, here, with the measure-form-ness, the specific. This very, and, is fit he says: &quot;the māṣaka-rakitikā.&quot; Of the to-be-measured, of the gold… ### Kārikā 7 — the object-attainment only through the distinction-un-distinction meaning Here, &quot;the being-ness-relation, the being-ness,&quot; is struck by the under-extension/regress/ purposelessness; &quot;the object-action, however,&quot; [is] the different-locus; &quot;the that-making-ness&quot; is not the always; with the cognition-birth, &quot;the thus-ness, the always, even,&quot; is not fit, like the sprout, of the seed, in the own-cognition-born, the un-wished, with the anvaya-vyatireka-grasping- non-being, from the cause-ness-non-determination; &quot;the object-action-making-fit-ness, in the true- false two, is hard-to-determine; with the other object-action, the regress; and of all, of this, in the non-manifestation, the hare&#x27;s-horn-similarity&quot; — this is [it]. &quot;The being-manifested-ness alone, the un-uprooted-reflexive-awareness, [is] the being-ness. And she, of the relation-and-the-rest, the un-alarming-alone.&quot; In the standing even, if anyone would say, &quot;from the hard-to-grasp: the world, first, desires the object-action; she, what is, of the relation-and-the-rest?&quot; — of that [objector], the heart, he comforts: &gt; Thus indeed the object-attainment would be, of the object-action-desiring mother; &gt; with the distinction-un-distinction-possessing meaning, by that, not the delusion, this-form. &quot;If the true you perceive: that, with the distinction-un-distinction-made, with the relation, without, not any, in the dealing-ground, is the object-action. Where even he is not cognized, there even, of-necessity, the inner-flashing alone sits.&quot; For: the pleasure-and-the-rest, desiring, this way he would desire, if he would know that; and thus he would know, if that-very, that, would be; and still, the un-desirable would be, of that, from the accomplishment. Thence, this is the fallen, the un-crossable: &quot;that which is, of the that-not-that-form two, the distinction-un-distinction-made- ness, the relation/universal-and-the-rest-form.&quot; And this, if the untrue; what-now, the true, is said? By that, whoever here does the delusion-dealing, he alone is the other, the deluded. &quot;That,&quot; in the grasping-sūtra two, the stability-use two, [are] fit-alone — the sūtra-meaning. ### The ||2|| colophon &quot;Thus, in the Śrī-mahāmāheśvara-Śrīmad-ācārya-Abhinavagupta-composed, in the Īśvarapratyabhijñāvivṛtivimarśinī, in the action-section, the distinction-un-distinction-reflexive- awareness, the second [vimarśa].&quot; > The cognitions of action, relation, universal, substance, direction and time have a substrate that is > at once one and many, and they are accepted as true — true by their stability and true by their > efficacy. The example: the body of Caitra — and of Maitra — although it differs by place, time, and > shape, shines forth without abandoning its oneness, in the recognition "this is the very same body." > That unity is the action, in the judgment "Caitra is walking." The substrate is both one (the unity of > the recognition) and many (the differences) — the bhedābheda. and efficacy.
